changes: M01 £100,000: label by the BOUND QUANTITY (DL ruling 12 Oct, AIE 0825 §3): as the Budget factor’s own amount it is that quantity’s level; bound to a spend limit it is the limit. No lexical budget rule.
H06 and M04 ‘3-month sales cycle’: adjudicated other (AIE #94 6120633627); recorded under adjudicate[].resolved.
labels.effect-rate narrowed (AIE 0825 §5): a per-unit rate is the level of a rate-parameter node OR an incremental effect, as the bound model quantity governs.
contrasts[]: the one missing semantic contrast (rate-parameter level vs incremental effect), folded in verbatim from the AIE’s unexecuted illustrations (0825 §5), not a second bank.

verbatim.about: Figure-bearing sentences from Paul's journey briefs and scripted typed turns (live-journey.mjs JOURNEYS: hiring, marketing, capacity), verbatim, for the factor-level verifier fix (#94 V1/V2). External corpus half 1: sentences and labels by the builder session (SYS2). Paraphrase half: a different model family, later. Never from the sealed set or c-acceptance.

prepared.status: PREPARED, not used by any test or build

labels.level: the speaker's own current level of a quantity (today), including a stated range or a chosen point
labels.effect-rate: a per-unit rate or effect size: the bound model quantity governs (AIE 0825 §3/§5) — the level of a rate-parameter node (e.g. tickets per week per specialist), or an incremental causal effect of one more unit
labels.target: what must be reached or not exceeded: a goal, a limit/ceiling or a deadline
labels.hypothetical: what an option would set, or a count of options/alternatives
labels.past: a past date or a figure from before today
labels.other-party: a figure attributed to someone else (a competitor, supplier, report): NONE in these sources

verbatim.scope: Only the lines live-journey.mjs scripts as Paul's typed turns (the transcripts carry no speaker marks) plus J1 LEVEL_BRIEF; no Olumi text. Sentences without a figure are left out (e.g. H L1 "Should I hire…", C "Use the exact goal label…", "This target is an absolute level, with no deadline.").
gaps: hypothetical only as option settings (C01, C03, C04)
